## VehicleStatsEstimationDisplay_00430f00 — VehicleStatsEstimationDisplay

**Summary:** Computes and formats vehicle performance estimates (acceleration, top speed, cornering G) for the setup display. Uses brake/fade model integration for acceleration, tire force model for cornering. Selects metric or imperial units based on UI encoding flag.
